analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches and supplied surrounding source against the canonical definition index and detailed T-041. These units contain documentation changes only: changelog.d/ssd-eviction-selection.md:3-10 and docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md head:532-546 describe replacing upfront sorting with a linear oldest probe and a bounded heap snapshot on failure. Concurrent mutations may change victim selection, but the documented contract retains leases, epoch validation, removal serialization and budget rechecking after external loss. No change here extends TTL, weakens authenticated cache scoping, exposes prompt-derived metadata, or changes encryption, authorization, attestation or billing. Existing cache-policy descriptions and historical qualification limitations are not new regressions.
Implementation verification remains material for integration: inspect provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.swift and SSDBlockIndex.swift, plus both active stores' eviction callers, to confirm bounded snapshot traversal, exclusion of the first tag, safe replacement/lease handling, and return to the disk budget after reconciliation. Relate those interactions to T-041/TB-007/A-001 and serving availability A-018. The documentation's assertions are not proof that these controls survive the implementation change; implementation source was not supplied in this batch. No independently supported security finding arises from these documentation edits.
